content.what_it_is: Commented MATLAB postprocessor that validates equal nfile/times lengths, derives a 2 m grid from eta_00001, loads mean-current, Hsig, and mask fields, masks dry points, plots Hsig and subsampled vectors with fixed sponge/wavemaker annotations, and adds a colorbar (lines 1-99).

params_defined.name: fdir
params_defined.range: input directory; overwrites preceding relative value

params_defined.name: times
params_defined.range: one display time per nfile entry

unresolved: The portable relative fdir at line 8 is unconditionally overwritten at line 9 by a machine-specific Windows path, so the script cannot use the documented local input directory without editing source.

The plotted scalar is Hsig loaded at line 62 and passed to pcolor at line 70, but the colorbar label is eta (m) at line 96. This copy/paste label assigns the wrong physical quantity to the visualization.
times is validated against nfile at lines 24-26 but never used in the active plot; no title is created, so the validation cannot make the intended time annotation appear.

Field dimensions are inferred from eta_00001 at lines 29-36, then u, v, ht, and mask are indexed together at lines 60-76 with no shape checks; inconsistent output shapes cause masking or quiver/pcolor dimension errors.
The only image output command is commented at line 100, so the configured paper geometry and completed figure are not saved.
